title: Goldfish Memory: 3‑Second Myth Busted

scenes.text: A goldfish can remember a maze for at least 5 months.
Everyone believes goldfish only have a 3‑second memory span.
scenes.label: 3‑second goldfish myth

scenes.text: Research shows goldfish can learn and retain information for weeks, even months, disproving the myth.
scenes.label: Goldfish remember weeks

scenes.text: Goldfish are smarter than you think.
scenes.label: Smart Goldfish
scenes.sub: They can be trained like pets.

scenes.text: Hit follow for your daily dose of wow.

description: The 3‑second myth is just a rumor—goldfish have impressive memory skills. Stay tuned for more hidden animal intelligence!
